dockerDesktopKubernetes.attemptedManualStepDefinition: Prerequisite/context check; failed literal registry creation; choose unused name/port (one substitution step); registry setup/push/pull; set target inputs; preflight plus deployment submission. acceptance.statement: These local results do not satisfy the AKS deployment timing criterion of no more than three manual steps and under five minutes from clone to deployment submission. That criterion requires a separate authorized Azure run, deferred by the user due to authentication. Both local paths passed initial health and server-rendered Needs cast; Kubernetes deploy, redeploy (revision 2) and Aspire destroy passed on the cleaned cluster. Human-interaction timing was not measured, and the successful retry is not a cold-build benchmark. No live model or interactive browser acceptance is claimed.
